title: High Contrast Research Icons
summary: A vivid, accessibility-minded semantic palette for quickly locating file categories in large or visually dense Studies.
details: High Contrast Research Icons pairs explicit single-letter category markers with vivid colors. It is intended for large explorers, low-contrast displays, and users who benefit from redundant shape and color cues.
features: High-separation colors across research file categories
Strong folder and archive cues in dense explorers
Explicit category markers with no executable or remote assets
